title: refactor(ui)!: retire test-only barrel helpers, `CommentSearchResult` and four dead `publicForm` keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSoxEEBsgSbf7fv9MkDm77d)_

Part of #25921 (items B1, B3, B4, B6 and B10 of the card thread's ledger, claim 6553495326; the card's other open items stay on it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从五个 ui 包的公共入口拿掉无人使用的面：core 的 `resetActionKeyWarnings`、react 的 `__resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings`、plugin-detail 的 `resetUnknownActivityTypeWarnings`（三个都是只给测试用的「清掉只警告一次的记忆」助手），types 的 `CommentSearchResult` 接口（唯一生产者早已退役），以及十个语言包里四个没有任何界面读取的 `publicForm.*` 文案。
- 为什么改：#25921 清理零消费者公开面；这几项在仓内、`examples/**` 与 hotcrm 中都没有非测试读者，留在入口上只会被当成公开 API 承诺。
- 风险与回滚：只删导出与文案，不改任何运行行为；跨包测试改为从声明模块直接引入助手。对外部 npm 使用者是破坏性变更，五个包各带一个 `!` changeset 写明替代写法。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts`（`export *` 改为具名列表，少了 reset）；`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/record-id-string-survivors-10078.test.ts`（钉子去掉一行）；`.changeset/25921-*.md` 五个文件。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -w -e resetActionKeyWarnings -e __resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings -e resetUnknownActivityTypeWarnings -- 'ui/packages/*/src/index.ts*'` 只剩三行「test-only and stays off the barrel」注释；`git grep -w CommentSearchResult -- ui/packages` 无结果。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（收窄公开入口，席位先做一次契约档复核）。

## What changes

- **B1 `@object-ui/core`:** `actions/index.ts` re-exported `./actionKeys.js` with `export *`, which put the test seam `resetActionKeyWarnings` on the package entry. It now re-exports the module's other ten names by name. Core's own tests already import the helper from `../actionKeys`.
- **B3 `@object-ui/react`:** `__resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings` leaves the entry. Nine cross-package tests imported it from `@object-ui/react` (the ledger said five; the import scan on the branch found nine) and now import it from `react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic`, the same module the vitest alias resolves the entry to, so the reset still clears the instance the code under test reads. Four app-shell tests already used that path.
- **B4 `@object-ui/plugin-detail`:** `resetUnknownActivityTypeWarnings` leaves the entry; its one cross-package test (`RecordDetailView.activityUnmappedType-5896`) imports `plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed`. The entry's docblock sentence that justified exporting it goes with it.
- **B6 `@object-ui/types`:** `CommentSearchResult` is deleted from `views.ts` and the entry. Its only producer, `useCommentSearch` in collaboration, retired in #28385. The record-id pin `record-id-string-survivors-10078` keeps its two other shapes (`RecordSubscription.recordId`, `DataSourceMutationEvent.id`) with their type rows, value controls and census rows.
- **B10 `@object-ui/i18n`:** `publicForm.consentRequired`, `rateLimited`, `redirectBlocked` and `requiredHint` leave all ten packs (40 lines). `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` lists all four CONFIRMED; the form page reads the nine sibling `publicForm` keys, none of these.
- Five changesets, one per package, each `patch` with a **BREAKING** banner, both declaration lines and an ADR-0087 disposition (`runtime-export-retired` for the four exports, `no-migration-prescription` for the keys).

Zero-consumer readings (ledger `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat-1/r2026-10-31b/out/25921-ledger.md`, objectstack `efb1620c`, hotcrm `a598256`, positive controls `SchemaRenderer` 1,198 files and `useRecordPresence` 113): each name has no non-test reader outside its package; every import of the four names on this branch was re-read from the import statements themselves.

## Verification

Head `fef5795d` (branch point `eeec88d1`).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/ packages/react/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/types/ packages/i18n/` plus the ten edited cross-package test files: Test Files 1022 passed, 7 failed, 1 skipped (1030). All seven reds read `no module symbol for packages/spec/dist/...d.mts` or the spec export probe: the closure had been built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` with declarations, the seven files rerun: 7 passed, 184 tests passed.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check` for types, core, react, plugin-detail, i18n, components, app-shell and console (each package's own `tsc --noEmit` plus its `tsconfig.test.json`, so the pin's compile-time rows and every repointed test are compiled): 78/78 tasks successful, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4901 tests passed.
- No ablation: the diff removes exports and dead strings; no tested behaviour changes.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 34 commands, all run with stdin closed, each exit recorded before any pipe; `--ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. All exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (prerequisite: run during the build) and exits 0 on rerun (0 entries above their recorded number).
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: 5 declared-breaking changesets, each with a verified disposition.
- Outside the derived set: `check-sdui-manifest` exit 0; `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files); `ui` `check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (0 new).
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; 194 changed lines (+104 / -90), under the 3,000 threshold. No governed path.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The ledger counted five cross-package importers of `__resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings`; it is nine (multi-line imports the first scan missed). All nine are repointed here, same item, same file class.
- Left on #25921 by the seat's pick: B2 (`clearSharedDiscoveryCache`), B5 (`resetRetiredDashboardNodeTypeReports`, declared published on purpose), B7 (S3/Azure upload adapters), B8 and B11 (governed), B9, B12, B13.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
